landing.heroTitle: From first enquiry to registry, nothing slips.
landing.heroBody: Real Vista is the CRM for property agencies. Leads, listings, site visits, paperwork and follow-ups live in one book your whole team works from.
landing.inviteNote: Built for agencies. Accounts are by invitation while we onboard our first teams.

events.enquiry: Enquiry imported from a property portal and assigned to Simran
events.visit: Site visit booked for Saturday at 11:00, three flats shortlisted
events.negotiation: Shortlist shared on WhatsApp as a link that expires in 7 days
events.token: Token of ₹2,00,000 recorded and the RERA certificate sent
events.registry: Registry done, commission booked against the deal

book.title: One book for the whole agency
book.body: Everything an agent needs between the first call and the registry office, kept where the rest of the team can see it.

enquiries.title: Every enquiry in one list
enquiries.body: Leads from property portals, your website and walk-ins land in the same list. Duplicates are matched on phone number, so one buyer is not called by three agents.

followUps.title: Site visits and follow-ups that come back to you
followUps.body: Book a visit or set a follow-up and the reminder reaches the agent in the app and by email. Lead scores cool when nobody has called, so a quiet lead stands out.

paperwork.title: Paperwork buyers ask for by name
paperwork.body: RERA certificates, sanctioned layouts, approval letters and brochures are stored as typed documents, so "is this project RERA registered?" is a field, not a hunt through attachments.

sharing.title: Share a shortlist, not your book
sharing.body: A share link shows only the fields you choose, expires on a date you set, can take a passcode, counts its views, and can be revoked at any time.

isolation.title: Your listings stay yours
isolation.body: Every record carries your workspace, enforced in the data layer. A request without one fails instead of returning another agency's listings.

yourWay.title: Your stages, your screens
yourWay.body: Deal stages, the screens in the sidebar, the fields on a property and your brand colours are settings for your agency, not a custom build.

howMany.a: Not many yet, and we would rather say so than invent a number. You would be early, which means the roadmap is still open to you and support comes from the people who wrote the code.

otherAgency.q: Can another agency see our listings?
otherAgency.a: No. Workspace separation is enforced in the data layer, so a query that arrives without a workspace context fails instead of returning someone else's records. Support access is read-only and logged.

spreadsheets.q: We already have years of data in spreadsheets.
spreadsheets.a: Bring the CSV or Excel file you have. The importer maps your column headings onto property fields, so the sheet does not have to match a template first.

leaving.a: Your listings and portfolio export to CSV from the screens that hold them, so the records open in any spreadsheet. Ask us for a full workspace export and you will get one.
